CREATE TABLE R2 (Y INT);
q1: SELECT DISTINCT X.X AS X FROM R1 AS X, R2 AS Y WHERE X.Y = Y.Y AND X.X = 1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT X.X AS X FROM R1 AS X, R1 AS Y, R2 AS Z WHERE X.X = Y.X AND X.Y = Z.Y AND X.X = 1
